summary: Iteration 11 tested end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: 186 of 187 tests pass and 4 obsolete OTP tests are skipped. All legacy test files were migrated to a conftest shim. The new test file covers Google-only auth, /api/site, admin settings, call-back support (validation, honeypot, timing check, rate limit) and the terms check before publish. Frontend checks that work: Google-only /login and its redirect; the landing style gallery (7 tiles, lazy images, scroll snap, arrows on desktop and none on mobile, preview modal, 'Use this style' going to Google when logged out or to /create?template=X with the template pre-selected when logged in); the /terms, /privacy, /refund and /pricing pages; /contact with its form; admin Support and Settings (editing the address updates /contact and /terms) and the redirect of hosts away from /admin; the wizard custom header box (collapsed by default, smooth 0.3s open, 'Using custom line' badge, auto-open when editing); the agree-terms checkbox before publish; the scratch date on the guest card, with no date under the names; and regression of the hub, timeline, event pages and effects toggle. Found 1 real HIGH bug: the Publish button on the Card detail page always fails with 422.

critical.issue: The draft card's Publish button (card-detail-publish-button) sends {...card, status:'published'}. That card came from GET, so agreed_terms is false (default). The backend require_terms() returns 422 'Please agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy before publishing', so a draft can never be published from the Card detail page. Reproduced in the UI (error toast) and in pytest test_carddetail_style_publish_of_draft.

minor.issue: The per-IP limit (10 per day) reads the FIRST X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. A random X-Forwarded-For header gets past the IP limit (confirmed in tests). The per-number limit of 3 still works. Use the last trusted hop, or the ingress real-IP header.
It stores the full default legal texts in Mongo on the first save. After that, changes to the TERMS/PRIVACY constants in code never reach the site. This is fine if intended, but worth knowing.

ui_bugs.issue: Publishing a draft from the card detail page always shows the error toast (see the backend critical issue). Fix: show the AgreeTerms checkbox there and send agreed_terms:true, or send the user to the wizard Preview step.

inert={open ? undefined : ""}: React 19 treats an empty string as false (console warning 'Received an empty string for a boolean attribute inert'). So the collapsed panel is NOT inert, and keyboard Tab can focus the hidden inputs. Use inert={!open}.

ui_bugs.component: Wizard save of an already-published card
ui_bugs.issue: 'Save changes' on a published card shows the toast 'Your card is live!' instead of a 'Changes saved' message.

issues: On light templates (Modern Minimal, Rose Gold), the white tile name overlaps the card body text and is hard to read. Use a stronger bottom gradient or a solid label strip.
The header logo sits on the wide container (x=330) while the content column starts at about x=487, so they look misaligned on desktop.
The Name and Mobile fields use placeholders only, with no visible labels. Once filled, nothing shows what each field is.
The checkbox is drawn as a circle and looks like a radio button.

action_items: Fix CardDetail.jsx publish(): it must send agreed_terms:true after the user ticks an AgreeTerms checkbox on that page, or send the user to /cards/{id}/edit at the Preview step. At the moment, publishing from Card detail always returns 422.
HeaderBoxes.jsx CustomHeaderBox: change inert={open ? undefined : ""} to inert={!open} (React 19).
Optional: in site_api.py, do not trust the first X-Forwarded-For value for the per-IP limit.
Optional: show a 'Changes saved' toast when saving an already-published card.
Update /app/auth_testing.md: it still describes Phone OTP login, which was removed.
critical_code_review_comments: require_terms runs on every PUT with status 'published', so every client path that re-saves a published card must send agreed_terms. The Wizard does this; CardDetail does not. The backend could instead accept the publish if the existing card is already published or has agreed_terms stored.
The CallbackIn honeypot and timing check silently return {ok:true}. That is good, but there is no log line, so admins cannot see blocked bot traffic.
server.py is 837 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider moving the auth and cards routes into routers, as was done for site_api.py.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (new: OTP-login shim plus auto agreed_terms for legacy tests, cleanup of TEST_user_*)

context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py turns old /api/auth/otp/* calls into new Google-style TEST_user_* sessions created directly in Mongo, and adds agreed_terms:true to published card payloads. Send the header X-No-Shim to bypass this. Call-back tests use a random X-Forwarded-For to avoid the 10-per-day IP limit. Guest card flow: intro-skip-button, then welcome-continue-button (the welcome screen also appears on direct /e2 links). Retest the CardDetail publish fix (pytest test_carddetail_style_publish_of_draft and the UI card-detail-publish-button).
rca of the issue: CardDetail.jsx line 79 builds the PUT body from the GET card. A draft has agreed_terms false, and server.require_terms rejects status=published unless agreed_terms is true. Reproduce: create a draft, open /cards/{id} and click Publish, and an error toast appears. Mitigation: add AgreeTerms on CardDetail and send agreed_terms:true, or let require_terms skip the check when the existing card already has agreed_terms or is already published.
